figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Design and construction of aconitic acid-producing cell factories. (A) The biosynthesis pathway of itaconic acid and proposed engineering strategy for trans- 
aconitic acid production in A. terreus. (B) Construction of aconitic acid-producing strain by deleting cadA gene. (C) The HPLC analysis of organic acid in the 
engineered A. terreus. Deletion of cadA abolished the production of itaconic acid and led to the accumulation of aconitic acid. (D) The time course of aconitic acid 
production of strain At-ΔcadA in shake flasks. IPM medium was used in the fermentation.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Construction and characterization of the A. terreus strains expressing aconitate isomerases. (A) The integration diagram of expression cassettes using Promoter 
PgpdAt and PcadA. (B) Fermentation analysis of the engineered strains in shake flasks. GT: strain ku80::PgpdAt-tbrA, GA: strain ku80::PgpdAt-adi1, CT: strain cadA:: 
PcadA-tbrA, and CA: strain cadA::PcadA-adi1. (C) Fermentation analysis of the mutants expressing tbrA using different promoters and integration sites. (D) Growth 
curves of CT81 and GT71 strains in shake flasks. (E) qRT-PCR analysis of the transcriptional level of aconitate isomerase TbrA in strains CT81 and GT71. The IPM 
medium was used in the fermentation analysis of all strains. Every transformant with 3 technical repeats, bars mean ± SD, significant differences were determined 
according to a p-value threshold (**, p < 0.01; ***, p < 0.001, ns, no significance).

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Optimization of fermentation conditions for 
TAA production. (A) The result of medium optimi­
zation through orthogonal experiments in shake 
flasks at 96 h. (B) The effect of micronutrient addition

fermentation using the optimized medium with and 
without L-Met in a 100 L bioreactor. (D) Optimization 
of DO using the optimized medium IPM-15#+L-Met

25% is more favorable for TAA production. Bars

determined according to a p-value threshold (*, p <
